Kept only so the legacy account migration can map the 24-title seed catalogue. Values are NOT trusted: pipelines/legacy_migration.py re-checks every id against the title of that MAL id in the target catalogue. Known issue: 'Hataraku Saibou' -> 35860 is wrong (35860 is 'Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san'); the migration resolves it by unique exact title to mal:37141 and reports the correction.
